headline: Indo Count Industries Limited: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations - Orbis Consulting AG, as trustee of The Lhochhar Trust has submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosures under Regulation 10(6)-Report to stock Exchange in respect of any acquisition made in…
detail: Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations - Orbis Consulting AG, as trustee of The Lhochhar Trust has submitted to the Exchange a copy of Disclosures under Regulation 10(6)-Report to stock Exchange in respect of any acquisition made in reliance upon exemption provided for in regulation 10 of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011.
